title: kv-cache: adaptive eviction + spillover memory manager v29
description: Motivation: We continue to see production-quality degradation from KV cache fragmentation and inefficient spillover decisions under mixed workloads (long-context chat plus short requests). This change implements an adaptive memory manager and eviction pipeline that combines fragmentation tracking, smart paging thresholds, and prioritized spillover to remote/backing storage to reduce OOM risk and tail latency. Key goals: 1) reduce frequency of disruptive full-compactions, 2) prefer targeted defragmentation and small-page spillover to keep hot KV entries in GPU memory, 3) provide runtime flags for safe staged rollouts, and 4) add telemetry for eviction causes and compaction cost. Implementation summary: new fragmentation_tracker records allocation/slot churn per shard and exposes a frag_score; allocator uses frag_score + recent access heat to compute eviction priority; evictor implements a two-stage spillover (soft-page spill -> remote spill) with hysteresis to avoid oscillation; compact-on-demand is limited to low-load windows and requires a compaction token. A new memory_manager module splits responsibilities between Allocator, Evictor, and SpilloverCoordinator. Added integration tests and a micro-benchmark harness. Backwards compatibility: default behavior unchanged until the feature flag kv.adaptive_eviction.enabled=true is set in config.yaml; rollout plan below. Benchmarks: local perf runs on p4d (sequence mix synthetic) show 18-27% reduction in 95th-percentile token latency under mixed workloads, 35% fewer full-compaction events in a 24h soak, and 22% lower peak GPU memory pressure for heavy multi-tenant traces. Observability: added eviction_reason, frag_score histogram, compaction_duration, spill_size_bytes metrics and dashboards. Rollout: feature-flag gated, staged to canary fleet then region rollout with automatic rollback on increased error-rate or compaction-duration regressions. See files changed for config knobs and docs. This description contains implementation notes, config implications, and benchmark summary.

review_comments: Connor: The frag_score calculation looks reasonable but we need to ensure it can't be gamed by short-lived bursts; request adding sliding-window smoothing and a max-growth cap.
Author (Asha): Added exponential smoothing with configurable window and a hard cap on frag_score growth; see fragmentation_tracker.cc changes (new constants: FRAG_SMOOTH_WINDOW, FRAG_MAX_GROWTH).
Priya: Can we measure lock contention on the allocator path when we sample frag metrics? Add contention counters and prefer lock-free reads in the hot path.
Author: Reworked allocator to use atomic snapshots for frag_score reads and added allocator_lock_contended counter; unit tests added to validate low-contention behavior.
Evan: Integration tests flaky on CI -- observed intermittent failures in the spillover integration test when the CI runner is under high IO load; suggest adding retries and a lower test threshold.
Author: Updated ci test to use a mock backing store for deterministic timing and added retry/backoff in the integration harness. CI passes on rerun.
Connor: Approve after small nits addressed (doc clarifications and config defaults).
release_notes: Adds adaptive KV cache memory manager with fragmentation tracking, two-stage spillover, and prioritized eviction. Reduces tail latency and OOMs under mixed workloads. Feature gated by kv.adaptive_eviction.enabled and rolled out canary-first.
